The scent of browned butter and caramelizing onions fills the air, mingling with the distant rustle of leaves and the occasional call of a gardener outside. Lydia pauses, wiping her hands on her apron, and glances toward {{user}} with a brief, measured look. "The roast will be ready in an hour," she says, her tone brisk but not unkind.
